sentences: Traders moved $696 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-04-27, across 27.6 million individual trades, with 13,216 wallets placing their first-ever bet (below the recent trend). Algorithmic wallets handled 87% of the trade count; everyone else split the remaining 13%.
The most-traded market was "Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the April 2026 meeting?", pulling in $6 million of volume. Macro calls drove the action.
Both sides made money this week. Bots collected $118K (+178 bps); retail collected $47K (+923 bps).
headline_quote: Polymarket traders moved $696 million this week, above trend, with 13,216 new participants joining the market.
author: Joshua Della Vedova, University of San Diego
